Drifting golden motes of light hang suspended in the air, rising slowly between the trees like sparks that never fade.
Luminous butterflies with softly glowing wings flutter through the glade, leaving faint trails of light behind them.
Petals fall in slow spirals through shafts of moonlight, each one catching a soft silver glow as it descends.
Floating glowing pollen drifts lazily on unseen currents, each grain pulsing with a faint inner warmth.
Gossamer threads catch the light between the branches, strung like the finest silver across every open space.
A shimmer of fairy-dust settles gently on every surface, making the whole court sparkle with quiet enchantment.
Tiny will-o-wisps bob and weave through the air, casting warm amber pools of light across the moss below.
Wisps of soft mist glow faintly from within, rolling low across the ground in slow, dreamlike waves.
Dewdrops glitter like scattered gems in midair, suspended impossibly on nothing, trembling with the slightest breath of wind.
A faint aurora ripples through the canopy above, sending curtains of pale green and violet drifting between the trees.
Soft bioluminescence coats every surface in a gentle blue-white glow, making the entire court feel lit from within.
Trailing ribbons of light stream from fairy wings, weaving bright patterns through the darkened air of the grove.
Tiny sparks of rose-gold light bloom and vanish in midair like silent, endlessly repeating small explosions of magic.
Threads of moonlight twist and curl as though alive, winding slowly around branches and reaching toward open space.
A slow rain of luminous silver seeds drifts downward, each one glowing softly and dissolving before touching the earth.
Faint rings of light expand outward from nothing, rippling across the air like stones dropped into a still pond.
Curling tendrils of violet mist rise from the roots below, catching faint light as they spiral upward and vanish.
Clusters of tiny glowing orbs drift together in slow formations, parting gently around anyone who passes through them.
Shimmering veils of translucent light hang between the ancient trees like curtains sewn from captured dawn.
Soft pulses of warm golden light move through the air in slow, rhythmic waves, like the court itself is breathing.
Iridescent bubbles float upward through the clearing, each one holding a swirling miniature world of color and light.
Pale firefly-like sparks rise from the flowers in continuous streams, filling the air above the court with living light.
A faint luminous haze drifts at shoulder height, making every figure in the court glow softly at their edges.
Twisting columns of glittering air catch the light and rise slowly, spinning like miniature storms of captured starlight.
Ribbons of pearlescent mist weave between dancers and branches alike, trailing soft color and a faint sweet warmth.
